A — SYSTEM CONTEXT (READ FIRST, BUILD NOTHING YET)

You are working inside a production Next.js 14 App Router monorepo called Torgima-Execution. This is a live, partially-built execution operating system. You must read the entire codebase before touching a single file.
A.1 — What already exists (DO NOT break or remove any of this)
prisma/schema.prisma — 42-table production schema. It already has a Validation model with basic fields.
services/ — engine services already built for signal, condition, control, task generation, feedback.

app/api/bhudhi/ — Bhudhi trigger router already exists. All AI calls route through it.
lib/bhudhi/ — Bhudhi prompt library with registered schemas and BhudhiLog writing.
A.2 — What you are building (The Erector Upgrade)

You are UPGRADING the existing validation system — not replacing it. The Erector is the name of the full validation system. It adds 9 validation engines, 30 Economic Archetype intelligence, civilization-specific reality scoring, time simulation, and a multi-screen validation UI.
The spec file TORGIMA_ERECTOR_VALIDATION_SYSTEM_COMPLETE.docx contains the complete architecture. Read the entire spec file before writing any code. It is your primary source of truth for this build.
Bhudhi = the AI intelligence layer. All Claude API calls. Runs INSIDE the engines.
The Erector = the validation system. What you are building in this prompt.
Torgima = the execution operating system. Already built. Blueprint launches here after The Erector completes.
These laws apply to every file you create or modify in this build. Violating any one of them breaks the system.

READ EVERY FILE BEFORE CHANGING IT. Read prisma/schema.prisma completely before adding tables. Read every existing service file before creating new services. Read every existing API route before creating new routes.

EXTEND, NEVER REPLACE. The existing Validation model gets new fields added. The existing onboarding flow gets new screens inserted. The existing validation API route gets upgraded with new engine calls. Nothing is deleted.
BHUDHI NEVER ACTS DIRECTLY. Every Bhudhi call must go through the BhudhiTriggerRouter with a registered Zod schema. Every call gets logged to BhudhiLog. Every call has a deterministic fallback.

RULE ENGINE OWNS ALL DECISIONS. Bhudhi interprets and generates narratives. The scoring engine calculates scores deterministically without AI. The control engine decides if a blueprint can launch. Bhudhi cannot override scores or launch blueprints.

NEVER GENERATE FAKE DATA. Bhudhi uses actual market intelligence from its training data for competitor analysis and industry trends. It must not fabricate specific competitor names without grounding in reality. If uncertain, it returns structured placeholders that the user can verify.
ARCHETYPE CONTEXT LOADS BEFORE ANY VALIDATION. No engine runs until the Economic Archetype is resolved from the user's location. All scores are archetype-adjusted.
ALL MUTATIONS GO THROUGH EVENTS. When validation completes, when a path is selected, when a blueprint level is chosen — emit the appropriate event. Never mutate state directly from a screen.
IDEMPOTENCY IS ENFORCED. Every validation run checks idempotency_key against existing ValidationRun records before processing. Duplicate submissions return the existing result.

NO PROMISES, NO GUARANTEES. The Erector shows probability estimates and difficulty projections. No language in any UI copy or Bhudhi output may promise a specific outcome. Use "probability", "estimated", "likely", "projected".

EXECUTION LANGUAGE THROUGHOUT. No motivational fluff. No "Great job!", "Amazing goal!", "You've got this!". Direct operational language only. Example: "Validation complete. Reality Score: 6.8/10. Adjusted path recommended." Not: "Awesome! Your goal looks great!"
